title: Homepage hero is merchant-editable
statement: The homepage hero must remain editable by merchants in the Magento Admin after launch (synthetic example requirement).

source.quote: Synthetic acceptance criterion: marketing team edits hero content without developer involvement.

ac: Marketing can edit hero message and media in Admin
No deploy step required for copy changes

title: Homepage hero section
statement: Full-width opening hero on the synthetic fashion homepage with headline, supporting copy and one CTA.

title: Licensed UI material never enters CMS content
statement: Licensed upstream UI source, templates and assets must never be copied into CMS content or the public toolkit repository; only metadata pointers and neutral semantics are allowed.
rationale: Keeps commercial licensing boundaries intact and the public store free of vendor bytes.
scope: KB-2 records and any derived CMS content

title: Hero is built on the Page Builder native banner
statement: The homepage hero uses the Page Builder native banner content type (full-width appearance); the licensed upstream hero stays an appearance-only neighbor (neighborOf), never a CMS-imported component.
chosen: Page Builder native banner (full-width appearance) — merchant-editable class matches the requirement

title: Homepage hero composition (PB native)
statement: Approved candidate composition: Page Builder native banner in the full-width appearance fulfils the homepage hero intent.

title: Hero approach approval (attested example)
statement: Synthetic example of an attested approval: a real human go occurred in-session but survives only as prose.
subject: Synthetic example only — attested approvals never satisfy approval-demanding gates.
